name: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd
title: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd - 543657 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bromine volumes 4,175 t (below ~4,500 t run-rate) with realisations ~INR300/kg, but bromine spot prices falling 30-40% in China and salt volumes down 12% on logistics; Q1 margin recovery is partly offset by execution misses.

capex.quote: the balance capex around 60% to 65% of that will happen in this financial year

triggers.label: China landed bromine price down 30-40%
triggers.quote: Landed prices in China, for example, have declined by 30% to 40% in the past 12 weeks.

triggers.label: Bromine volume 4,175 t vs ~4,500 t run-rate
triggers.quote: we were 325 tons short in the quarter

triggers.label: Bromine recovery: 20-25k t exit run-rate

summary.headline: Archean Q1 FY27 standalone revenue rose 14% YoY to INR3,321m and EBITDA margin expanded to 25.3%, but logistics costs and Hajipir road works kept salt volumes down 12%.
